status_definitions.portable: A named finite checker, selected implementation or portable launcher is supplied. This does not make every program in the historical source directory portable or prove a theorem.
status_definitions.archival: Original source/data or verified identical bytes are supplied for inspection. Archival entry points are not claimed runnable and records are not new experiments.
status_definitions.external: The reference is to a separately acquired dependency source/revision. Build instructions may be supplied, but those instructions are not the referenced dependency source.
status_definitions.generated: The reference denotes historical environment-specific build material intentionally omitted. A supplied recipe can create a new build; it does not recreate historical bytes.
status_definitions.unresolved: No unambiguous artifact target has been established. Absence of this status does not imply full supplementary reproducibility.
